Fieldwork

Know your audience. Literally.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems alongside the community, with a mentor checking every step. Consumer insight used to mean talking to people. It still does.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Want a story for your portfolio that is true? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students work on a live Earth5R project near home, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
